evidence: vllm/v1/spec_decode/ngram_proposer_gpu.py:369: scatter_ of integer token ids into the token id table | vllm/v1/spec_decode/ngram_proposer_gpu.py:350-351: write positions are num_tokens_no_spec + arange(max_new_tokens), consecutive and distinct within a row | vllm/v1/spec_decode/ngram_proposer_gpu.py:360-361: positions past max_seq_len are clamped to max_seq_len - 1 and their masked write carries the value gathered from that position
notes: Integer token ids, not floating point, so not order-dependent accumulation. Positions within a row are consecutive and distinct. The clamp at line 360 can fold out-of-bounds positions onto max_seq_len - 1, where the clamped write carries the pre-scatter value and an in-bounds write at the same position carries a new token; that collision is only possible when a request reaches the table's last column.
